text:
tanvi_eng: quick help — PR #14027 needs to land before the freeze at 18:00 UTC today. All tests pass locally but windows-x64 matrix keeps failing with a flaky test (TestFileWatcher). Can someone rerun the matrix or advise if we should hold?

kevin_sre: I can look. CI queue is a bit backlogged because of the nightly stress runs. If it's the single flaky test we can try a targeted rerun for that job. Which job name exactly?

tanvi_eng: it's `windows-x64-matrix / node14` (shows up as windows-x64 in the dashboard). Here's the failing line from the last run:```
ERROR: TestFileWatcher - file change event not received within timeout
    at FileWatcher.emit (tests/watcher.spec.js:42:15)
```

kevin_sre: thanks. I can trigger a rerun for that job only. Heads up: if the matrix keeps flaking, our fallback is to merge to the canary branch and run a short canary (we have a 30m slot). But freeze starts in ~3h so tight.

morgan_dev: I can do the rebase and push the commit if that helps. If the test is flaky maybe a tiny retry will pass. tag me and I'll rebase and push in ~10m.

alex_reviewer: I skimmed the diff — small doc fix + a guard in file watcher. Looks fine to me. I'll add an approval once CI is green. :+1:

tanvi_eng: great, thanks. Kevin — please rerun when free. Morgan — please rebase and push after Kevin kicks it off. If it still flakes, I can open a tiny follow-up to skip the flaky assertion under Windows and follow up post-freeze.

kevin_sre: kicked off targeted rerun: https://ci.internal/reports/2498765420/targeted-rerun (you'll see the job rerun only). ETA ~8m. I'll monitor and report back.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled release freeze window starts at 18:00 UTC. No merges to `main` without approvals from release leads.

morgan_dev: rebased and force-pushed as `tanvi/14027-rebase-2`. Link: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/14027. Pushed with `git push --force origin tanvi/14027-rebase-2`.

kevin_sre: rerun finished — windows-x64 passed on rerun. All other matrix jobs are green. Alex, can you give final approve?

alex_reviewer: giving approval now. :shipit:

sarah_pm: quick note — if this is user-facing, make sure telemetry change is in the rollout notes. Otherwise ok to land before freeze as a bugfix.

tanvi_eng: thanks everyone — merging now. Will monitor canary for 30m and escalate if anything odd. If canary looks good, I won't promote to full release until after the freeze window ends unless we have sign off.

morgan_dev: thanks, congrats on the merge.

kevin_sre: nice. If it flaps again, ping me and I can do a broader queue bump. :eyes:
